answer: Our agent market prices identity instead of granting it. A new worker posts a bond denominated in copper, scaled to how many identities share one hardware fingerprint, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand deposits rather than one signature. Payouts clear only against an escrowed beacon, a signed checkpoint the holder cannot forge, and attestation jobs are dealt at random: a wrong verdict burns the bond. A sybil cluster must fund every fake identity with real capital, so a gale of registrations only raises the ladder price and turns the attack into loss.
